description: Dataset of Toward Intelligent Communication Systems for High-Speed Railway is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Arwidya Tantri Agtusia, Ratna Nurmayni (National Research and Innovation Agency). This dataset contains the complete list of 352 scientific articles analyzed in the study “Toward Intelligent Communication Systems for High-Speed Railway: Themes, Challenges, and Future Perspectives.” The dataset was compiled to support a bibliometric and thematic analysis of High-Speed Railway (HSR) communication systems, covering publications from 2005 to 2024. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
